title: tebako-bench result v1
description: One benchmark leg's result document (spec 27 §6): runner metadata + resolved versions + per-run records + per-(workload × target × mode) statistics. Machine-written by `tebako-bench run`, machine-merged by `tebako-bench report`. This schema is the STRUCTURAL contract; the crate's serde model is the same shape (MECE cross-check in unit tests). Unknown keys are tolerated at every level for forward compatibility; schema_version pins the version.

suite.description: The suite document's `name` — the report merges only same-suite results.

triplet.description: The release workflow's platform vocabulary — a result row joins against a release row without a translation table.

runs_on.description: The CI runner label (e.g. ubuntu-24.04, macos-14, windows-latest).

runner.description: Mandatory environment metadata — numbers without their environment are not numbers.

runtime.description: The RESOLVED runtime (e.g. 0.16.9-3.3.12), never the requested line.

image_format.description: The v2 arms' image backend; numbers across formats never mix in one statistic.

versions.description: What actually ran. Fields may be absent when no arm of that world ran on the triplet (all-gap results stay honest).

runs.description: One record per attempted run AND one per named gap. Gaps are explicit data — silent omission is a schema violation (invariant 9).

stats.description: Per (workload × target × mode) statistics over status "ok" runs only. Absent for arms with zero ok runs.

status.description: ok: expectation met, all metrics present. failed: ran, expectation missed — never enters statistics. timeout: killed at the workload's timeout_s. unavailable: the named-gap record — the arm was never attempted on this triplet; reason is mandatory.

cpu_user_s.description: POSIX: wait4 rusage of the reaped child; Windows: GetProcessTimes user. spec 27 §4.

peak_rss_bytes.description: Bytes, ALWAYS — the sampler normalizes ru_maxrss's KiB (Linux/musl) vs bytes (macOS) at record time. Windows: PeakWorkingSetSize.

error.description: failed runs: names the missed expectation.

reason.description: unavailable rows: the human-readable gap reason.

n.description: Count of status "ok" runs in this cell.

min_wall_s.description: The cross-noise-comparable figure on shared runners (noise inflates, never deflates).

stdev_wall_s.description: Sample standard deviation (n−1); absent when n < 2.
